class.name: FmodAudioBusLayout
class.brief_description: Serializable configuration for FMOD audio buses and effect slots.
class.description: Stores ordered bus and effect configuration using stable IDs. Master has ID 0 and remains first. Buses may send to any target that does not create a cycle; reordering only changes display order. Save and load this resource with ResourceSaver and ResourceLoader. Serialized properties use bus/index/... paths and a format version. FMOD channel groups, DSPs, metering, and capture buffers belong to the runtime managed by FmodServer and are not serialized. Set audio/fmod/sync_godot_audio_buses to false and reload the project to use an independent layout. audio/fmod/default_bus_layout defaults to res://default_fmod_bus_layout.tres. A missing or invalid default uses an in-memory Master. The editor Dock saves authoring edits after 0.8 seconds; runtime changes made directly to FmodAudioBus or effect instances do not save configuration.

method.name: get_bus_count
method.description: Returns the number of configured buses, including Master.

method.name: get_bus_ids
method.description: Returns stable bus IDs in display order. Master is always the first item with ID [code]0[/code]. IDs are not array indices.

method.name: find_bus_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the bus named [param name], or [code]-1[/code] when it does not exist.

method.name: get_bus_name
method.description: Returns the name of bus [param id], or an empty [StringName] for an unknown ID.

method.name: add_bus
method.description: Adds a bus named [param name] and routes it to [param send_id]. Returns its stable ID, or [code]-1[/code] if the name is empty, contains a comma, is already used, or the target does not exist.

method.name: remove_bus
method.description: Removes bus [param id] and its effect slots. Buses sending to it are redirected to its previous send target. Bound runtime channels are redirected on the next update. Master cannot be removed. Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: move_bus
method.description: Moves bus [param id] to the final display [param index], from [code]1[/code] to [method get_bus_count] minus one. Routing and IDs are preserved. Master cannot be moved. Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: rename_bus
method.description: Renames bus [param id] while preserving its ID, routing, and runtime instances. The name must be unique, nonempty, and contain no comma. Master cannot be renamed. Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: can_send_to
method.description: Returns whether bus [param id] can send to [param target]. Both buses must exist. Master sends to the output device; self-sends and cycles are rejected. Display order does not restrict sends.

method.name: set_bus_send
method.description: Routes bus [param id] to [param target]. Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [method can_send_to] rejects the route.

method.name: get_bus_send
method.description: Returns the send target ID of bus [param id], or [code]-1[/code] for an unknown ID. Master returns [code]0[/code].

method.name: set_bus_volume_db
method.description: Sets the configured volume of bus [param id] in decibels. Non-finite values and unknown IDs are ignored.

method.name: get_bus_volume_db
method.description: Returns the configured volume of bus [param id] in decibels, or [code]0.0[/code] for an unknown ID.

method.name: set_bus_mute
method.description: Sets the configured mute flag of bus [param id]. When any bus is soloed, the solo routing path takes precedence over configured mute flags.

method.name: is_bus_mute
method.description: Returns the configured mute flag of bus [param id]. This excludes muting caused by Solo. Returns [code]false[/code] for an unknown ID.

method.name: set_bus_solo
method.description: Sets the configured solo flag of bus [param id]. Bound runtimes keep each soloed bus and its path to Master audible, and mute unrelated buses.

method.name: is_bus_solo
method.description: Returns the configured solo flag of bus [param id], or [code]false[/code] for an unknown ID.

method.name: set_bus_bypass
method.description: Sets bypass for the managed effect slots on bus [param id]. Slot configuration and DSP state are retained. This does not bypass the bus fader or unrelated DSPs added through low-level APIs.

method.name: is_bus_bypass
method.description: Returns the configured bypass flag of bus [param id], or [code]false[/code] for an unknown ID.

method.name: add_bus_effect
method.description: Inserts [param effect] into bus [param bus_id] before [param index]. A negative index appends it. Returns a stable slot ID, or [code]-1[/code] for an invalid bus, null effect, or out-of-range index. Multiple slots may share a configuration resource; each bound slot receives its own runtime instance.

method.name: remove_bus_effect
method.description: Removes slot [param slot_id] from bus [param bus_id]. Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: move_bus_effect
method.description: Moves slot [param slot_id] from [param bus_id] to [param target_bus], inserting it before [param index] in the target list before removal. The index may equal the target slot count to append. The stable slot ID and bound DSP state are preserved. Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: set_bus_effect_enabled
method.description: Sets whether slot [param slot_id] on bus [param bus_id] is enabled. Disabled slots retain their runtime instances in bypass. The bus bypass flag also bypasses enabled slots. Unknown IDs are ignored.

method.name: is_bus_effect_enabled
method.description: Returns the configured enabled flag of slot [param slot_id] on bus [param bus_id], or [code]false[/code] for unknown IDs.

method.name: get_bus_effect
method.description: Returns the configuration resource for slot [param slot_id] on bus [param bus_id], or [code]null[/code]. Use [method FmodServer.get_bus_effect_instance] to access live Capture, SpectrumAnalyzer, or Record data.

method.name: get_bus_effect_ids
method.description: Returns stable slot IDs for bus [param bus_id] in processing order, or an empty array for an unknown bus.

method.name: set_state
method.description: Atomically replaces the bus configuration with [param state], using the format returned by [method get_state]. Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA], preserving the previous configuration when validation fails. The layout accepts up to 4096 buses and 512 slots per bus.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns an ordered array of bus dictionaries containing [code]id[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]send_id[/code], [code]volume_db[/code], [code]solo[/code], [code]mute[/code], [code]bypass_fx[/code], and [code]effects[/code]. Each effect dictionary contains [code]id[/code], [code]effect[/code], and [code]enabled[/code]. Effect resources are shared references. Use with [method set_state] for structural undo and redo.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns [constant OK] for a supported format version, a valid Master, unique names and IDs, non-null effect resources, finite volumes, and acyclic routes. Otherwise returns [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA].
